title: Two kinds of clue

doesNotKnow: The modeled investigation separates a large-scale structure from microscopic mineral features. Different observations can support or challenge an impact interpretation; each must be identified and dated independently.

misconception: The first apparent interpretation is the only possible one.
objective: A suspected impact is investigated using a crater-shaped structure and minerals with impact-related shock features. Why inspect both?
